problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI 07: S2S facade Cauchy influence
problem.question: Does one fixed Cauchy facade influence at the inherited Huber scale improve the full recursive trajectory?

next_step: Review the uniform full-sequence experiment; repository extension stays default off.
